name: Churro Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 200 mg per can, printed on the front; caffeine is also added as an ingredient, on top of what the coffee carries
summary: Churro flavor on Loco's zero-sugar oat milk cold brew, read off a can in hand. The front prints 200 mg of caffeine, 0 g of sugar and 80 calories in 11 fl oz; the panel shows 0 g total and 0 g added sugars and 1 g of protein, with sucralose doing the sweetening and caffeine added on top of the coffee. No price yet: we have not confirmed where Loco sells it online.
